Package neupaths.api

Class ReceptorSpec

java.lang.Object
neupaths.api.ReceptorSpec
public final class ReceptorSpec extends Object
NeuPaths receptor specification. A receptor has the following characteristics:
  • name - A receptor is identified by a name.
  • mode - A receptor is Buffered or Non-buffered (see ReceptorMode.)
  • stimulus type - A receptor accepts a specified stimulus type.
